verses.en: When the sky is torn apart,
each soul will know what it has done and what it has left undone.
Mankind, what has lured you away from God,
verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ

verses.en: your generous Lord, who created you, shaped you, proportioned you,

verses.ar: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ

verses.en: Yet you still take the Judgement to be a lie!
the good will live in bliss,
and the wicked will burn in the Fire.
They will enter it on the Day of Judgement
and they will find no escape.
What will explain to you what the Day of Judgement is?
Yes! What will explain to you what the Day of Judgement is?
verses.ar: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ

verses.en: The Day when no soul will be able to do anything for another; on that Day, command will belong to God.
verses.ar: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِّنَفْسٍ شَيْـًٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلَّهِ
